retyped.name: diggs:drumMass
retyped.note: 3.0.0 typed drumMass as a force (diggs:ForceMeasureType); 3.1 types it as a mass (diggs:MassMeasureType). A value given in a force unit is the weight of the drum: rename the element to drumWeight, value and uom unchanged. A value in a mass unit is valid as it stands.
